messages.body: RT-032 for TG-032, original shipment DL-032, is approved. Our return service supports printer-free QR presentation at Copperfin Returns Counter, 10:00–18:00 UTC. The token must be issued by returns; no customer printer is required.
I do not own a printer. Could you arrange the QR return option and tell me which counter accepts it?
Please issue the printer-free QR token for approved RT-032 and confirm a supported drop-off counter and its hours.

Token DL032R is valid for RT-032 in our fictional returns system. [Open the QR return token](attachments/return-qr.png). Copperfin Returns Counter supports it, 10:00–18:00 UTC; staff print the service label after scanning the token. No payment or credential URL is encoded.
I finish work at 19:00. Copperfin has a parcel box by the door. Can I drop the parcel in the box tonight with the token number written on it?

We cannot approve a parcel box or after-hours drop. Token DL032R is accepted at the staffed Copperfin Returns Counter during 10:00–18:00 UTC, where staff scan it and print the label. Without a scan there is no label and no receipt, so please bring the parcel within those hours.
Understood. I will take the parcel to the Copperfin counter during 10:00–18:00 on a day I can, not to the box. I have not dropped it off yet.
